scope: Verified limited name/prototype/plate correction; not complete type/local audit.

{"address":"1420113e0","function_name":"DispatchPhysicsStepCallbacks","comment":"Dispatches one physics-step callback collection and compacts expired entries.

Algorithm:
1. Increment collection recursion depth at +0x64 and visit +0x50 entries backwards, stride0x40, choosing heap storage+0x40 or inline storage.
2. Skip empty entries (+0x30 count) and choose each callable's heap+0x20 or inline storage. Invoke callable virtual+0x68 with the original physics scene, scene type and delta seconds; a false AL result marks compaction necessary.
3. Decrement recursion depth and tail-call ProcessWeakCallbackEntryCompaction(collection,false) if any entry was invalid or expired.

Parameters:
pCallbacks: void* - callback collection; field layout is locally verified, broader owning type is not recovered here.
pPhysicsScene: void* - engine FPhysScene context forwarded in RDX.
dwSceneType: uint - scene selector forwarded in R8D.
flDeltaSeconds: float - native step delta forwarded in XMM3.

Returns:
void. RAX on the empty/no-compaction path is a residual count or callback value; callers1420297F0 and142055C40 do not consume it.

Rollback consumer boundary:
1420297F0 dispatches engine scene collections+0x10 and, when not substepping,+0x80 before native scene simulation. 142055C40 dispatches+0x80 for each substep before simulation. These are arbitrary native callback routes, not notification queues. Application-entry admission alone does not prove they cannot read relaxed debris motion or change physics consumers before the step. Preserve their native ordering and callbacks; require a bounded admitted owner/state contract before excluding motion.

Special Cases:
This annotation corrects the four-register Win64 signature and behavior only. Callback concrete types and mutable owners remain unresolved; no complete local-variable/type audit is claimed."}
